subject: Pilot concession and billing cutover for Novacare timebox eval
messages:
From: Priya Sethi <priya@novacare.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novacare.io>
Date: 2025-10-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — pilot top-up vs short extension?

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for walking us through the throughput numbers yesterday. We’re between two options on our end and wanted your recommendation:

1) Add a modest top-up of credits (we were thinking ~30% of current consumption) to close out the 30-day pilot.
2) Add a short 14-day extension to the current timebox and keep our existing token/pricing profile.

Two constraints: we need predictable final invoicing for finance by Nov 10, and the clinical team needs one extra week of priority support for go/no-go testing.

Can you outline the commercial tradeoffs (billing cadence, estimated final cost, and any one-time fees) so I can present to procurement tomorrow? If it helps, I can loop in our procurement lead.

Best,
Priya Sethi
Director, AI Engineering
Novacare Health

Attachment: pilot-usage-snapshot.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sethi <priya@novacare.io>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novacare.io>
Date: 2025-10-22T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot top-up vs short extension?

Hi Priya —

Thanks — appreciate the constraints. High level tradeoffs:

- 14-day extension (timebox): We can extend the current environment with no pricing change; you keep your existing token rates and SLA. Invoicing will be a pro-rated invoice for the extra days and will show up on the November statement. No onboarding or change fees.

- Top-up credits: We can issue a one-time token top-up at a discounted rate — I can offer a 15% credit on the top-up amount if purchased as a single one-off invoice. This keeps the end date the same but gives you more runway immediately.

Other considerations:
- Support: Priority support hours are billable; as a gesture I can include one complimentary week of priority monitoring (up to 10 incident-hours) if you pick the 14-day extension.
- Procurement/invoice timing: If you need visible invoicing before Nov 10, an invoice for a top-up can be generated immediately; the extension pro-rate will invoice when the extension is applied (usually within 48 hours of confirmation).

I attached a short Mutual Action Plan template and a draft addendum that would cover the extension and the support credit. If you want the discount to be higher we’ll need a short internal approval — I can loop in our finance lead if that’s required.

Options summary (pick one):
A) 14-day extension + 1 week complimentary priority monitoring (no change to token pricing).
B) One-time token top-up (we can do it at list price or with a 15% single-invoice discount).

If you confirm which you prefer I’ll prepare the addendum and billing note.

— Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Novacare_MutualActionPlan.xlsx; Novacare_Pilot_Addendum.docx
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novacare.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya@novacare.io>
Date: 2025-10-22T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot top-up vs short extension?

Ava —

Thanks for the options. Procurement is going to push for the top-up (easier to reconcile), but they’ve asked whether Redwood can be flexible on the discount — 15% is a good start but can you do 25% on the top-up if we commit to a short post-pilot evaluation call for conversion?

Also, we will need clear language in the addendum that ensures the top-up will not change the baseline pricing if we convert to a committed plan within 30 days.

Can you advise whether that higher discount is doable or if we should stick with the extension?

— Carlos
VP Product, Novacare Health
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-22T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — pilot top-up vs short extension? 

David / Marissa —

Forwarding Novacare’s ask. Key points: customer prefers top-up (procurement) and is asking for 25% discount on a one-time top-up if they agree to a short conversion evaluation call. They also want contractual language that top-up won’t rebase pricing on conversion. I’m recommending: we accept 20% and include a short clause that top-up is a one-time credit only and won’t alter list pricing on conversion; include the standard conversion protection.

Questions for pricing/legal:
- Is 20% an okay concession without additional approvals?
- Can we commit contractually to a non-rebasing clause in the addendum template (one-liner: "Top-up credits are non-refundable and non-recurring and will not change subscription pricing upon conversion")?

If you approve, I’ll send Draft A (20% top-up discount + DocuSign addendum) back to Novacare. If you want to hold firm at 15% or require further signoff, tell me and I’ll push extension option instead.

Thanks —
— Ava
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sethi <priya@novacare.io>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novacare.io>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot top-up vs short extension? (Agreement)

Hi Priya / Carlos —

Thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. We can do a one-time token top-up at a 20% discount (single invoice) on the requested amount, with two commercial conditions:

1) Top-up is a one-time, non-recurring credit and will not rebase or change list pricing if you convert to a committed plan within 30 days. We’ll add the following clause to the addendum: "Top-up credits are non-refundable, non-recurring, and expressly do not modify Redwood’s list pricing or pricing tiers in any subsequent agreement."

2) We ask for a 30-minute conversion review call within 14 days after the pilot end to discuss next steps and gather feedback (this is to accelerate a smooth conversion if you decide to move forward).

Per your invoicing window note, we can generate the invoice immediately upon confirmation. I attached the addendum with the added language and a DocuSign link for signature. I also included the mutual action plan to capture the conversion call.

If that works I’ll route the DocuSign and generate an immediate invoice for the agreed top-up.

Best,
— Ava
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Novacare_Pilot_Addendum.docx (updated), Novacare_MutualActionPlan.xlsx
Related: https://www.docusign.net/novacare-addendum-12345
